top_signals.title: Xi Warns Against ‘Rampant’ Protectionism Ahead of Trump Talks
top_signals.summary: Xi Jinping urged Asia-Pacific economies to deepen cooperation as he warned against rising unilateralism and protectionism, setting out a defense of free trade as China hosts global leaders for high-stakes talks on trade and technology.
